d: On the sidelines of the much-awaited launch of Toyota Innova Hycross Facelift, Prashant V. Singh, Editor - LiveMint, spoke to Vikram Gulati, Country Head and Executive Vice President (Corporate Affairs & Governance) at Toyota Kirloskar Motor (TKM) in India. Ahead of launch at JW Marriott, Gulati spoke on design, features, bookings, pricing, availability, safety and much more. Watch full interview here!
